versions.name: Worth Ranch

features.note: Brazos River frontage with a marina.
Two pools, also used for water basketball and volleyball.
The Climbing Gardens, natural cliffs used for climbing and rappelling.
Summer camp showers; campsites otherwise have latrines.

versions.summary: Longhorn Council's traditional Scouts BSA resident summer camp near Fort Worth on the Brazos River, offering climbing gardens, river aquatics, two pools, hiking on Kyle Mountain, and an ATV program.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/662-WRSummerCamp2026); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
